verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Registrar features like at-cost pricing, DNSSEC, WHOIS redaction, auto-renew, and Cloudflare nameservers, but never mentions email forwarding for registered domains nor explicitly bundles free SSL as part of the Registrar offering. missing for 10: any evidence of email forwarding/routing tied to Registrar, explicit statement that free SSL is bundled with domain registration.
